question.text: The chemical nature of hydrogen peroxide is:

options.text: Oxidizing and reducing agent in both acidic and basic medium.
Oxidizing agent in acidic medium, but not in basic medium
Oxidizing and reducing agent in acidic medium, but not in basic medium
Reducing agent in basic medium, but not in acidic medium.

solution.text: H2O2 acts as an oxidizing agent, as well as a reducing agent in both acidic as well as basic mediums.
